mapper.select: SELECT client_photo FROM client WHERE client_photo IS NOT NULL AND client_photo != '' UNION SELECT doctor_photo FROM doctor WHERE doctor_photo IS NOT NULL AND doctor_photo != '' UNION SELECT pet_photo FROM pet WHERE pet_photo IS NOT NULL AND pet_photo != ''

SELECT notice_id, notice_title, notice_file, notice_type, a.create_time, a.update_time, is_disable, b.doctor_name AS create_name, c.doctor_name AS update_name FROM notice AS a LEFT JOIN doctor AS b ON a.creat_id = b.doctor_id LEFT JOIN doctor AS c ON a.update_id = c.doctor_id WHERE a.is_del = 0
and (a.notice_title like #{noticeKw} or b.doctor_name like #{noticeKw})
ORDER BY a.sort DESC, a.create_time DESC
SELECT notice_id, notice_title, notice_file, create_time FROM notice WHERE is_del = 0 AND is_disable = 0 AND notice_type = 0 ORDER BY sort DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT notice_id, notice_title, create_time FROM notice WHERE is_del = 0 AND is_disable = 0 AND notice_type = 0
AND notice_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{noticeName}, '%')
ORDER BY sort DESC, create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET notice_title=#{noticeTitle}, sort=#{sort}, update_id=#{updateId}, update_time=now() WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (notice_title, notice_file, creat_id, create_time, update_id, update_time, notice_type, sort) VALUES (#{noticeTitle}, #{noticeFile}, #{creatId}, now(), #{creatId}, now(), 0, #{sort})
INSERT INTO notice (notice_title, notice_file, creat_id, create_time, update_id, update_time, notice_type) VALUES (#{noticeTitle}, #{noticeFile}, 0, now(), 0, now(), 1)
